sub500.desc: Telecom, commercial and mobile military sets.

mid.desc: Hospitals, malls, water and mid-industrial standby.

hhp.desc: Large industrial, oil and gas, airports and campus prime power.

vhhp.desc: Utility standby, refineries, colocation data centres.

dc.desc: Hyperscale and AI data centre blocks, 60 Hz Saudi and 50 Hz UAE and Kuwait.

competitiveCards.title: Rehlko launches programme to double Changzhou backup power capacity from 5.5 GW to 11 GW
competitiveCards.sowhat: Changzhou explicitly serves EMEA, so Gulf distributors can now source KD Series up to 4,000 kW from a plant with 11 GW annual capacity. This is a direct supply and price lever against Cummins Arabia in KSA, UAE and Kuwait data centre and industrial tenders. Cummins Arabia should benchmark Changzhou-sourced pricing on 1.5 MW to 3 MW sets and reinforce total cost of ownership and local service arguments.

sec.read: Changzhou explicitly serves EMEA, so Gulf distributors can now source KD Series up to 4,000 kW from a plant with 11 GW annual capacity.

competitiveCards.title: Weichai H1 2026: data centre genset sales above 1,400 units, more than all of 2025
competitiveCards.sowhat: Run-rate of roughly 2,800 data centre gensets a year puts Weichai among the largest volume producers of data centre sets worldwide. Gulf hyperscalers that buy globally will see Weichai and Baudouin on approved vendor lists, which erodes the reference advantage Cummins holds in the region.

competitiveCards.title: Q2 2026: first USD 20 billion quarter, power generation +72%, backlog USD 72 billion, 10 MW medium-speed gas engine production restarted for 1.5 GW
competitiveCards.sowhat: The 10 MW medium-speed gas platform fills the gap between Cat high-speed gensets and Solar turbines, directly bracketing Cummins HSK78G and QSK95 gas offers for Gulf industrial and utility prime power. Cummins Arabia should expect Cat to bid gas plants at 10 to 100 MW in Saudi and Kuwait with a single-OEM stack by 2027.

competitiveCards.title: Generac Q2 2026: data centre backlog about US$1.6 billion, second hyperscale agreement secured, C&I up 29 percent
competitiveCards.sowhat: Two hyperscale frame agreements in one quarter means Generac is now a standing option for hyperscaler standby fleets. Cummins Arabia's exposure is in Saudi and UAE hyperscale campuses awarded through global procurement.

competitiveCards.title: Generac's Baudouin M55 based 2.25 to 3.25 MW data centre sets gain a global hyperscale supply agreement covering the Middle East
competitiveCards.sowhat: Baudouin engines reach the Gulf through two brands at once: Baudouin's own WPG sets and Generac's SDMD sets. In a hyperscale programme awarded globally, Cummins Arabia can lose Saudi or UAE sites without ever seeing a local tender. It should work with Cummins Inc. on global account coverage rather than rely on local bids alone.

sec.read: Market: GCC. Generac's SDMD2250, SDMD2500 (12M55, 65.6 L) and SDMD3250 (16M55, 87.5 L) diesel sets use Baudouin M55 engines with Marathon DataMAX alternators and DSE G8601 controls.

competitiveCards.title: Generac signs global supply agreement with a hyperscale data centre operator covering APAC, Europe, Middle East and Latin America
competitiveCards.sowhat: The Middle East is explicitly in scope, so Gulf hyperscale sites can be supplied from a global frame agreement without a local tender. Cummins Arabia should coordinate with Cummins Inc. global hyperscale account teams to defend Saudi and UAE campuses and make sure local service capability is part of the global pitch.

sec.read: Market: GCC. The unnamed hyperscaler qualified Generac after factory visits and performance reviews.

competitiveCards.title: Q1 2026: Caterpillar triples large reciprocating engine capacity plan to about 3x 2024 levels, adds about 15 GW per year, power generation +48%
competitiveCards.sowhat: This is the structural threat. By 2028 Cat will have far more 3500, C175 and G3500 engine supply than today and will need non-US outlets for it, and the Gulf is the obvious one. Cummins Arabia should lock multi-year supply agreements and service contracts with key Saudi and UAE accounts in 2026 and 2027 while Cat is still capacity constrained.

competitiveCards.title: Rehlko secures another 1.7 GW of hyperscale backup power orders in 60 days
competitiveCards.sowhat: Rehlko is converting its data centre strategy into gigawatt scale orders and will carry those hyperscaler relationships into the Gulf as the same operators build in KSA and UAE. Cummins Arabia should map which hyperscalers have standardised on Rehlko in North America and pre-empt their Gulf procurement with local stock, 60 Hz KSA references and service coverage.

competitiveCards.title: Weichai 2025 results: data centre backup power sales up 259 percent, M-series engines pass 10,000 units, 20M61 5 MW engine launched
competitiveCards.sowhat: Weichai now has the volume and cash flow to price aggressively in export markets and to fund Baudouin's Gulf marketing. Growth of this scale in one year also means Weichai capacity is real, which supports the lead-time argument used against Cummins in Gulf tenders.

sec.read: Weichai now has the volume and cash flow to price aggressively in export markets and to fund Baudouin's Gulf marketing.

competitiveCards.title: Al Mulla Power Solutions builds mtu MRO headquarters in Ahmadi, Kuwait, completion September 2026
competitiveCards.sowhat: Kuwait gets a factory-standard mtu overhaul centre next to KOC's Ahmadi operations for the first time. That closes the service gap that has favoured Cummins Arabia in Kuwait oil sector and government tenders. Cummins Arabia should lock in multi-year service agreements with Kuwait key accounts before the centre opens.

sec.read: Market: Kuwait. A 5,000 sqm plot with over 3,600 sqm built-up area in Ahmadi industrial zone will house an MRO centre, workshops, spare parts, technical support, a training centre and offices, built to Rolls-Royce Power Systems standards.

competitiveCards.title: FY2025 results: Power Generation above USD 10 billion (+30%), Q4 power generation +44%, Middle East called out as strong, 2026 tariff cost USD 2.6 billion, price realisation about +2%
competitiveCards.sowhat: Cat leadership sees the Middle East as a strong market entering 2026 and is pushing price up about 2% while absorbing tariffs. Cummins Arabia has a pricing window on US-built product costs; it should quantify landed cost differences per node and sell that to Saudi and UAE buyers before Cat mitigates.

competitiveCards.title: Seven mtu 20V4000 DS3600 gensets for Kuwait International Airport Terminal 2
competitiveCards.sowhat: This is mtu's first public Kuwait win through the new Al Mulla channel and it lands in the 3 MVA class where Cummins Arabia sells C3000 and C3500 class sets. A government airport reference plus a Turkish EPC relationship (Limak) gives mtu credibility for the next Kuwait infrastructure packages. Cummins Arabia should map Limak and other Turkish EPC procurement teams active in Kuwait and KSA.

sec.read: Market: Kuwait. Rolls-Royce is supplying seven 20-cylinder Series 4000 DS3600 backup gensets through local partner Al Mulla Power Systems for the Limak-built Terminal 2, awarded by DGCA with the Ministry of Public Works.

competitiveCards.title: Makeen becomes exclusive mtu distributor for stationary power across Saudi Arabia
competitiveCards.sowhat: For the first time mtu gensets have an exclusive Saudi channel owned by Aramco, HD Hyundai and Dussur, with a localisation licence behind it. That combination speaks directly to Aramco, SEC, NEOM and IKTVA-scored buyers that Cummins Arabia sells to. Cummins Arabia's answer is installed base, 60 Hz stock and its own local content record; it should expect Makeen to appear in Eastern Province industrial and data centre tenders within 12 months.

sec.read: Market: Saudi Arabia. Effective 2025-10-01, Saudi Engines Manufacturing Company (Makeen) extended its exclusive mtu distributorship from mobile applications to stationary power across the Kingdom, covering genuine parts, factory-certified MRO and integrated power solutions.

competitiveCards.title: Baudouin exhibits at Data Center Nation Riyadh with 2,000 to 5,250 kVA M33 and M55 gensets
competitiveCards.sowhat: Direct marketing into the Saudi data centre pipeline. Cummins Arabia should make sure Saudi data centre consultants and EPCs have Cummins DCC ratings, 60 Hz performance data and local service commitments in hand before Baudouin's lead-time pitch lands.

sec.read: Market: Saudi Arabia. Baudouin presented its data centre genset range and previewed the 20M55 to Saudi operators and developers, citing Uptime Institute pre-approval and ISO 8528 G3 load acceptance.

competitiveCards.title: FG Wilson Catalyst 2026: 60th anniversary global dealer conference in Belfast
competitiveCards.sowhat: A dealer conference of this scale signals a channel re-energising exercise. Expect dealer targets and campaign activity in the Gulf over the next 12 months, especially from FG Wilson (Engineering) FZE and TAMGO. Cummins Arabia should expect sharper FG Wilson pricing in the 500 to 1,500 kVA commercial band.

competitiveCards.title: Yuchai (China Yuchai International, Singapore HQ, NYSE CYD) is the second Chinese engine OEM whose genset engines appear in low-cost Gulf packages
competitiveCards.sowhat: Yuchai-powered sets from Chinese packagers compete at the low end of Gulf tenders (typically below 1,000 kVA). Cummins Arabia's exposure is in price-led utility, telecom and construction bids in KSA and Kuwait rather than in data centres. Track Chinese packager registrations on Etimad and CAPT rather than Yuchai itself.

sec.read: Market: GCC. China Yuchai International, through Guangxi Yuchai Machinery, produces engines for generator sets alongside marine and industrial engines.

competitiveCards.title: Energy Vault signs 1.25 GW integrated power deal in Texas for a hyperscaler with an EPC deploying Caterpillar gensets
competitiveCards.sowhat: Third-party BESS integrators are packaging Cat gensets by default. In the Gulf, Cummins Arabia should court the BESS integrators and EPCs (not just end users) so that Cummins is the default genset in their bills of material.

competitiveCards.title: Stella Power orders large quantity of Solar Turbines Titan 130 packages for data centre and industrial onsite power
competitiveCards.sowhat: Cat can offer turbines above the reciprocating band, so in Gulf prime power tenders above 20 MW it can shift the buyer from gensets to turbines. Cummins Arabia should hold the reciprocating advantages (part-load efficiency, modular redundancy, N+1 flexibility) in its bid narrative.

competitiveCards.title: H1 2026: Power Systems order intake +55% to GBP 4.6bn, power generation revenue +41%, margin 20.3%
competitiveCards.sowhat: mtu is sold out for 2026 and half sold for 2027. Any Gulf project needing Series 4000 sets inside 12 months will struggle to get mtu slots, which is a direct window for Cummins Arabia to win on delivery in UAE and KSA data centre and utility tenders through 2027.

competitiveCards.title: Baudouin partners with EODev on solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) power, commercial launch September 2026
competitiveCards.sowhat: Europe only for now, but SOFC baseload for data centres is the kind of grid-independent offer Gulf hyperscalers will ask about as grid connection queues lengthen. Cummins Arabia should track whether Baudouin brings SOFC to Middle East Energy 2027.

sec.read: Europe only for now, but SOFC baseload for data centres is the kind of grid-independent offer Gulf hyperscalers will ask about as grid connection queues lengthen.

competitiveCards.title: Rehlko invests EUR 12 million to expand Cholet, France switchgear plant
competitiveCards.sowhat: Rehlko is shortening lead times on the paralleling switchgear that ships with large genset packages to EMEA including the Gulf. Cummins Arabia should quantify its own switchgear lead times and partner capacity so it is not outpaced on complete package delivery.

competitiveCards.title: Mitsubishi Power wins boiler supply for heavy oil to gas fuel conversion at Jeddah South and Shuqaiq plants
competitiveCards.sowhat: Context only: it deepens Mitsubishi's standing with Saudi utility buyers and local EPCs. No genset scope. Cummins Arabia should note that Dar Al Balad and similar EPCs now have a working Mitsubishi relationship that could extend to backup power packages.

sec.read: Market: Saudi Arabia. Contract from Saudi Energy for dual fuel conversion of four units at each of two 2.9 GW west coast plants, with Dar Al Balad as local EPC and Mitsubishi Corporation Machinery as agent.

competitiveCards.title: Mankato logistics centre opens; Series 4000 genset capacity more than doubles by end 2026
competitiveCards.sowhat: Doubled 60 Hz Series 4000 output is the supply side of a future push into Saudi Arabia's 60 Hz data centre market. Lead time, not product, has been mtu's Gulf weakness; from 2027 that argument weakens for Cummins Arabia in KSA.

sec.read: Doubled 60 Hz Series 4000 output is the supply side of a future push into Saudi Arabia's 60 Hz data centre market.

competitiveCards.title: Generac promotes Niccolo Borracchini to EVP International (Generac and Pramac outside US and Canada)
competitiveCards.sowhat: A Pramac-rooted leader running international suggests the Gulf will be served through the Pramac Dubai structure. Cummins Arabia should track whether PR Middle East FZE begins quoting large Generac data centre sets in UAE and KSA.

competitiveCards.title: Zahid Tractor publishes updated Saudi branch map (22 to 24 branches) and a 75 years of partnership campaign
competitiveCards.sowhat: Zahid's network already covers every Saudi industrial cluster including the northern and southern regions where Cummins Arabia has thinner coverage. Any Cummins Arabia branch plan should be checked against this map to avoid opening where Cat service is already dense and to prioritise gaps.

sec.read: Market: Saudi Arabia.

competitiveCards.title: Rehlko integrates WB Power Services into its UK and EMEA platform
competitiveCards.sowhat: The EMEA leadership now runs a standardised delivery model that can be extended to the Middle East through distributors. Cummins Arabia should expect more consistent Rehlko bids on Gulf data centre tenders led by UK and European consultants.

sec.read: The EMEA leadership now runs a standardised delivery model that can be extended to the Middle East through distributors.

competitiveCards.title: Generac buys Belvidere, Illinois plant to add large-megawatt genset packaging capacity from Q1 2027, after February 2026 Enercon acquisition
competitiveCards.sowhat: More US packaging capacity shortens Generac lead times for export orders in 2027. Cummins Arabia should expect Generac to quote competitive delivery on Gulf hyperscale sites from 2027.

competitiveCards.title: Rehlko opens Kenosha, Wisconsin assembly for eFRAME enclosures up to 4 MW
competitiveCards.sowhat: Capacity is being added for enclosed 4 MW packages, the format hyperscalers specify. This is North American capacity, so lead time relief for Gulf orders would come from Brest and Changzhou instead. Cummins Arabia should track quoted lead times from Rehlko distributors on 2.5 MW to 4 MW enclosed sets.

competitiveCards.title: PROPWR signs framework with Caterpillar for at least 1.5 GW of gas generation assets, option to about 2.1 GW
competitiveCards.sowhat: Cat is locking multi-year framework volume with power-as-a-service operators. Gulf equivalents (Altaaqa, Aggreko type players and Saudi IPP developers) are the accounts where Cummins Arabia should propose its own multi-year fleet frameworks before Cat dealers do.

competitiveCards.title: Generac Q1 2026: C&I sales up 28 percent on data centre demand; final-stage vendor approval with multiple hyperscalers
competitiveCards.sowhat: Confirms Generac is becoming a scale supplier of large data centre gensets. For Cummins Arabia this is a new name on hyperscaler approved vendor lists rather than an immediate local competitor.

competitiveCards.title: MHI-ESA terminates Indonesia dealership for MGS-G gas generator sets
competitiveCards.sowhat: Shows Mitsubishi actively manages its gas genset channel. In the Middle East MGS-G is sold direct by MHIES-ME with no local dealer, so gas genset coverage in KSA, UAE and Kuwait is thin. Cummins Arabia's gas offer faces little Mitsubishi channel pressure.

competitiveCards.title: Caterpillar, OnePWR Solutions and Vero3 collaborate on 500 MW gas power with carbon capture for data centres
competitiveCards.sowhat: Gas plus carbon capture is a decarbonisation answer Gulf regulators and NEOM-type clients will ask for. Cummins Arabia has no equivalent bundled offer; it should decide whether to partner for capture or lean on HVO and hydrogen-ready messaging.

competitiveCards.title: FY2025: Power Systems revenue GBP 4.9bn (+19%), margin 17.4%, data centre revenue +35%, order cover 79% for 2026
competitiveCards.sowhat: mtu is entering 2026 with most of its genset slots sold and margins rising, so it will not chase price in Gulf tenders; it will chase specification and hyperscaler relationships. Cummins Arabia can win on availability and total cost in 2026 but should plan for a more aggressive mtu from 2027 when new capacity frees up.

competitiveCards.title: Rolls-Royce reports over 80% Saudisation and 450 mtu marine engines in Saudi fleets ahead of World Defense Show 2026
competitiveCards.sowhat: Rolls-Royce is packaging aerospace, naval and mtu activity into one Saudi localisation story, which is how it will approach GAMI, SAMI and PIF-linked buyers of power equipment. Cummins Arabia should quantify its own Saudi headcount, training and local content so procurement teams see a comparable Vision 2030 narrative.

sec.read: Market: Saudi Arabia. Rolls-Royce said Saudi nationals are over 80% of its Kingdom workforce, cited 450 mtu marine engines in Saudi naval and government fleets and the 50 high-speed train engines, and named Makeen as its local power solutions joint venture with its own WDS stand.

competitiveCards.title: Volvo Penta reports doubled industrial engine sales in North America and targets the data centre boom
competitiveCards.sowhat: Growth is US-led. No Gulf-specific volume signal found.

competitiveCards.title: AIP Corp, Caterpillar and Boyd CAT form alliance for 2 GW of G3516 gas gensets plus BESS at Monarch Compute Campus, 8 GW planned
competitiveCards.sowhat: Cat's G3516 is being positioned as prime power infrastructure, not standby. If Gulf hyperscale developers such as those building for Humain or Khazna adopt behind-the-meter gas, Cat arrives with a referenceable multi-GW installed base. Cummins Arabia should build its own gas prime power references now.

sec.read: Cat's G3516 is being positioned as prime power infrastructure, not standby.

competitiveCards.title: Zahid Tractor runs 2026 Sales Campus with Caterpillar management at Zahid Business Park
competitiveCards.sowhat: Zahid is standardising a digital, uptime-guarantee sales motion across machines, power and rental in the Kingdom. Cummins Arabia should expect connected-asset and uptime-guarantee terms to appear in Saudi genset bids and should have PowerCommand Cloud and service-level commitments ready as standard.

sec.read: Market: Saudi Arabia. Three-day Sales Campus (13 to 15 January 2026) for the full Zahid sales organisation, product support, SMD and Ejar rental divisions with Caterpillar management and instructors, built around a customer-back approach, VisionLink, Cat Inspect and uptime guarantees.

competitiveCards.title: Five-year guaranteed Series 4000 capacity agreement with UK packager AVK
competitiveCards.sowhat: Rolls-Royce is pre-selling Series 4000 capacity to European data centre packagers. That is good for Cummins Arabia in the short term because it leaves less uncommitted mtu volume for Gulf distributors, but it also signals mtu will prioritise hyperscaler channel partners; if a Gulf packager gets a similar deal, treat it as a direct threat.

sec.read: Rolls-Royce is pre-selling Series 4000 capacity to European data centre packagers.

competitiveCards.title: Rehlko and Alghanem deliver data centre backup power in Jordan
competitiveCards.sowhat: This is the closest published Rehlko data centre reference to the Gulf. It shows Rehlko using long-tenured regional distributors for data centre wins in the Levant. The same Midis Group channel that serves Jordan also serves KSA, UAE and Kuwait, so replication in the Gulf is plausible.

competitiveCards.title: Al-Bahar and Caterpillar exhibit together at ADIPEC 2025 in Abu Dhabi
competitiveCards.sowhat: Cat is keeping its oil and gas power and marine franchise warm with ADNOC-ecosystem buyers through the dealer. Cummins Arabia should track ADNOC and Lamprell type accounts where Al-Bahar has installed 3500 series sets and target the rebuild and CVA renewal cycle.

sec.read: Market: United Arab Emirates. Al-Bahar and Caterpillar shared stand 9430 at ADIPEC 2025 (3 to 6 November, ADNEC), showcasing high-efficiency engines, rebuild programmes and data-driven lifecycle solutions for oil and gas customers.

competitiveCards.title: Generac standardises 1,000 to 1,500 kW US industrial diesel sets on Perkins 4008 (30.6 L) and 4012/D46L (45.8 L) engines
competitiveCards.sowhat: Perkins gains a large 60 Hz OEM volume base through Generac, which feeds 60 Hz product maturity relevant to Saudi Arabia. If Generac's Gulf dealers (Atlas Power Solutions, Watan Altaqa, Al Mulla) bring these sets to KSA, Cummins Arabia faces Perkins-powered 1,000 to 1,500 kW packages under a second brand.

competitiveCards.title: Q3 2025: record USD 17.6 billion sales, Energy & Transportation USD 8.4 billion (+17%), backlog USD 39.8 billion led by data centre customers
competitiveCards.sowhat: Backlog growth driven by data centres means Cat factory slots are being consumed by US hyperscalers. In the near term this leaves room for Cummins Arabia on lead time in the Gulf; the window narrows as Cat capacity comes online.

competitiveCards.title: Mitsubishi Power unveils first locally assembled M501JAC gas turbine at Dammam, marking 60 years in Saudi Arabia
competitiveCards.sowhat: Mitsubishi Power's Saudi localisation is in gas turbines, not gensets, but it gives the Mitsubishi name Vision 2030 credibility with Aramco, SEC and the Eastern Province. If MHIET ever routes MGS assembly or service through Dammam, that would be a direct challenge. Cummins Arabia should keep its own Saudi localisation and IKTVA content visible to the same buyers.

sec.read: Market: Saudi Arabia. The Dammam facility assembled its first JAC turbine, destined for the 475 MW Amiral cogeneration plant in Jubail (TAQA and JERA) serving SATORP.

competitiveCards.title: Largest ever mtu battery order: 582 MWh / 291 MW EnergyPack for Ignitis in Lithuania
competitiveCards.sowhat: mtu's BESS business is grid-scale and utility-led, unlike Cummins' BESS positioning. The relevance for Cummins Arabia is hybrid genset plus storage tenders in KSA and UAE, where mtu can now show half-gigawatt-hour references and its own controller. Cummins Arabia should track EnergyPack quotes into Saudi utility and NEOM-type microgrid work.

sec.read: mtu's BESS business is grid-scale and utility-led, unlike Cummins' BESS positioning.

competitiveCards.title: Rolls-Royce and Microsoft publish joint position paper on HVO for data centre backup power
competitiveCards.sowhat: A published Microsoft co-authorship is a hyperscaler endorsement mtu will reuse in UAE and Saudi data centre bids where Microsoft, and the operators building for it, specify backup fleets. Cummins Arabia should be ready with its own HVO approval documentation for the QSK series when hyperscaler specs arrive.

sec.read: A published Microsoft co-authorship is a hyperscaler endorsement mtu will reuse in UAE and Saudi data centre bids where Microsoft, and the operators building for it, specify backup fleets.

competitiveCards.title: 50 mtu 12V4000 R64 engines ordered for Saudi Arabia's Dammam to Riyadh high-speed trains
competitiveCards.sowhat: Not a genset sale, but it puts 50 plus Series 4000 engines into Saudi Arabia with a service obligation, which strengthens the case for a Makeen Series 4000 parts and MRO base in the Eastern Province. That base would also serve stationary Series 4000 gensets sold against Cummins Arabia's QSK60 and QSK78 range.

sec.read: Market: Saudi Arabia. Stadler ordered 50 mtu Series 4000 rail engines (1,500 kW each, EU Stage V) for 10 trains running up to 200 km/h, with an option for 40 more.

competitiveCards.title: Joule, Caterpillar and Wheeler agree 4 GW data centre power in Utah on G3520K gensets with 1.1 GWh BESS
competitiveCards.sowhat: This is the template Cat will bring to Gulf data centre developers: gas gensets as prime power plus BESS in one dealer-led package. Cummins Arabia needs an equivalent prime power gas plus storage story for Saudi and UAE campuses before Cat dealers pitch it.

sec.read: This is the template Cat will bring to Gulf data centre developers: gas gensets as prime power plus BESS in one dealer-led package.

competitiveCards.title: MTU Yuchai Power JV in Suzhou adds Series 2000 G06 and Series 4000 S83 production, 3,000 engines built to date
competitiveCards.sowhat: Chinese built mtu engines create a lower cost route for Chinese genset packagers exporting to the Gulf. Cummins Arabia already competes with Chinese packaged Cummins engines from Cummins' own China plants; mtu now has a comparable lever. Watch for Suzhou sourced mtu gensets appearing in UAE and KSA rental and construction tenders.

sec.read: Chinese built mtu engines create a lower cost route for Chinese genset packagers exporting to the Gulf.

competitiveCards.title: Rehlko completes acquisition of The Wilmott Group (WB Power Services and Wiltech Acoustics)
competitiveCards.sowhat: Rehlko is building an end-to-end data centre delivery model in EMEA (engineering, enclosures, commissioning, service) rather than selling loose gensets. Gulf hyperscale customers procuring through UK and European consultants will see this offer. Cummins Arabia should be ready to quote full turnkey scope, not equipment only.

competitiveCards.title: USD 75 million Aiken, South Carolina expansion to machine Series 4000 engines in the US from July 2027
competitiveCards.sowhat: A second Series 4000 engine source reduces mtu's single-plant dependency on Friedrichshafen, which has historically capped what its Gulf distributors could deliver in a given year. Monitor mtu lead-time quotes in KSA and UAE from 2027.

sec.read: A second Series 4000 engine source reduces mtu's single-plant dependency on Friedrichshafen, which has historically capped what its Gulf distributors could deliver in a given year.

competitiveCards.title: USD 24 million Mankato expansion to lift Series 4000 genset output by more than 120% by 2026
competitiveCards.sowhat: Mankato builds 60 Hz sets, the frequency Saudi Arabia runs on. More 60 Hz Series 4000 capacity shortens the lead times mtu can quote into Saudi data centre and industrial tenders from 2026. Cummins Arabia's 60 Hz lead-time advantage in KSA narrows as this ramps.

sec.read: Mankato builds 60 Hz sets, the frequency Saudi Arabia runs on.

competitiveCards.title: Jubaili Bros (Perkins packager) signs strategic partnership with Wholesale Electric Asia for oil and gas power packages
competitiveCards.sowhat: Jubaili Bros is scaling as a regional packager and now targets oil and gas packages, a core Cummins Arabia segment in KSA and Kuwait. Its Perkins-based JP range runs to 2,250 kVA prime. Cummins Arabia should monitor Jubaili's Saudi factory ramp and its bids into Aramco contractor and rental fleets.

sec.read: Market: United Arab Emirates. Jubaili Bros (1,600 employees, 11 countries, 3 manufacturing plants, 1.5 GW annual capacity) and Singapore based WEA agreed to cooperate on power generation distribution and customised oil and gas packages across the Middle East, Africa and Southeast Asia.

competitiveCards.title: Rehlko and Liebherr expand KD Series engine partnership
competitiveCards.sowhat: The KD engine is a Liebherr-derived design, so Rehlko depends on a single external engine partner for its flagship range. Cummins Arabia can position Cummins in-house engine design, manufacturing and Gulf parts stock as a supply certainty argument in tenders.

sec.read: The KD engine is a Liebherr-derived design, so Rehlko depends on a single external engine partner for its flagship range.

competitiveCards.title: MHI-ESA adds MGS assembly plant in Johor Bahru, Malaysia with WDG Assembly
competitiveCards.sowhat: Extra MGS capacity in Asia shortens lead times for Gulf orders that ship from Singapore. Cummins Arabia should expect Mitsubishi dealers in KSA and UAE to quote firmer delivery on 1.5 MVA to 2.75 MVA sets.

competitiveCards.title: Zahid Tractor marks 75 years as Caterpillar's Saudi dealer at Jeddah flagship branch
competitiveCards.sowhat: The Zahid relationship is the deepest dealer franchise in the Kingdom and is not going to be disrupted. Cummins Arabia should not expect Cat account churn in KSA from dealer instability; wins have to come on product, lead time and service economics.

sec.read: Market: Saudi Arabia. Zahid Tractor and Caterpillar executives, key clients and employees from across the Kingdom gathered at the Jeddah flagship branch to mark 75 years of the dealership, coinciding with Caterpillar's 2025 centennial.

competitiveCards.title: Jubaili Bros adds MWM gas gensets (400 to 4,500 kW) for Middle East and Africa
competitiveCards.sowhat: This is context for the Perkins channel: Jubaili now covers diesel (Perkins) and gas (MWM), which lets it bid full gas and diesel packages against Cummins Arabia's HSK78G and diesel range. Included as a late 2024 baseline because it shapes 2025 to 2026 bidding behaviour.

sec.read: This is context for the Perkins channel: Jubaili now covers diesel (Perkins) and gas (MWM), which lets it bid full gas and diesel packages against Cummins Arabia's HSK78G and diesel range.
Market: GCC. MWM (Mannheim) and Jubaili Bros (Dubai) announced a partnership to offer MWM gas generators of 400 to 4,500 kW electrical across MEA, under Group CEO Dr Marcus Schumacher.

competitiveCards.title: Kohler Energy rebrands as Rehlko under Platinum Equity ownership
competitiveCards.sowhat: Private equity ownership means Rehlko is being run for growth and exit, with capital allocated to data centre gensets. The Kohler-SDMO brand equity in the Gulf is being migrated to Rehlko, which creates a window where distributor and end-user recognition is weaker. Cummins Arabia should press its brand continuity with consultants and data centre EPCs during this transition.

competitiveCards.title: Baudouin joins the Gulf Data Centre Association (GCDA) alongside Italian and Spanish data centre associations (baseline)
competitiveCards.sowhat: GCDA membership gives Baudouin a seat in the Gulf data centre community and its events. Cummins Arabia should confirm its own visibility in GCDA programmes so Baudouin does not become the default OEM voice there.

sec.read: Market: GCC. Baudouin announced collaborations with GCDA (covering Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and UAE), IDA (Italy) and SPAIN DC, promoting M Series engines 25 to 4,150 kVA with cooling above 50 degree C ambient and HVO testing.

competitiveCards.title: FG Wilson appoints Roger Kennedy as General Manager
competitiveCards.sowhat: A commercially oriented GM tends to prioritise dealer growth and volume. Combined with the Catalyst 2026 conference, this points to a growth push rather than a hold strategy for FG Wilson.

competitiveCards.title: Al Mulla Power Solutions adds Generac as a second genset brand alongside mtu in Kuwait
competitiveCards.sowhat: Al Mulla is now a multi-brand house covering small Generac sets up to large mtu units, which dilutes focus but also means it will compete across Cummins Arabia's whole Kuwait range. The opportunity is that mtu no longer has a dedicated Kuwait partner; Cummins Arabia can position single-brand accountability with Kuwait government and oil sector buyers.

sec.read: Market: Kuwait. AMPS signed with Generac Power Systems to distribute diesel, gas and bi-fuel gensets for residential, commercial and industrial customers in Kuwait, with 24/7 after-sales support.

competitiveCards.title: MHI-ESA hosts MGS Sales and Service Maintenance Conference 2026 for Asia Pacific dealers in Bali
competitiveCards.sowhat: Mitsubishi's dealer development effort is centred on Asia Pacific; the Middle East network is small (one dealer per Gulf country) and run from Sharjah. Cummins Arabia's branch depth in KSA, UAE and Kuwait is a clear service argument against MGS in tenders that score after-sales coverage.

competitiveCards.title: Rehlko and INNIO sign multi-year framework for 1.25 GW of gas engines
competitiveCards.sowhat: The agreement is confined to Clarke Energy territories, and Clarke Energy lists no office in KSA, UAE or Kuwait. Gulf gas genset demand from data centres and grid constrained sites therefore has no Rehlko gas channel today. Cummins Arabia should push HSK78G and gas genset packages into Gulf data centre and utility bids before Rehlko or another INNIO packager fills that gap.

marketCards.title: Providing mobile generators for the mobile and fixed units of Sharurah Force and its affiliated units
marketCards.meta: Tender · Royal Saudi Land Forces (Ground Forces), Sharurah Force · closes 08 Oct 2026
marketCards.company: Royal Saudi Land Forces (Ground Forces), Sharurah Force
marketCards.sowhat: Border-sector military units buy rugged, low-maintenance mobile sets and value service reach into Sharurah and Najran. Cummins Arabia's Saudi service footprint is the argument; price competition comes from Perkins and FG Wilson packagers sold through Zahid and local assemblers.

marketCards.title: Renting, installing, operating and maintaining electrical generators with fuel for the King Abdulaziz Camel Festival, eleventh edition
marketCards.meta: Tender · Camel Club (Saudi Camel Club) · closes 06 Oct 2026
marketCards.sowhat: Cummins Arabia does not bid rental turnkey itself, so the play is through rental fleet owners running Cummins-powered sets. The win here is fleet supply and parts pull-through, not the tender itself. Aggreko and Altaaqa are the incumbents on large Saudi event power.

marketCards.title: Supply of spare parts (generator, electric, engine driven, portable) for the Forsan System on the West Coast, 60020987
marketCards.meta: Tender · Saudi Water Authority (SWA, formerly SWCC) · closes 06 Oct 2026
marketCards.sowhat: SWA issues a steady stream of generator parts and maintenance tenders for pumping stations (Beish-Merba backup generator maintenance closed 2026-09-17 on the same portal). A parts framework or maintenance contract with SWA is a recurring revenue line, and it positions Cummins Arabia for standby packages on new transmission systems.

marketCards.title: Providing generators for Sweihan and Razin Mazayna 2026
marketCards.meta: Tender · Abu Dhabi Heritage Authority · closes 30 Sep 2026
marketCards.sowhat: Small, seasonal, and won by rental houses. Useful only as fleet pull-through for Cummins-powered rental partners in Abu Dhabi.

marketCards.title: Battery charger (DSE 9470 MKII) for emergency diesel generator, Cummins P1550C 550 kVA with QSX15-G8 engine, 3 units
marketCards.meta: Tender · Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) · closes 29 Sep 2026
marketCards.sowhat: DEWA is buying accessories for Cummins sets piecemeal on RFQ. Cummins Arabia should convert this into a parts and service framework covering DEWA's emergency genset fleet before an independent controls trader takes the annuity.

marketCards.title: Battery storage, absorbed glass mat type, 12 VDC 200 Ah, for diesel generator applications
marketCards.meta: Tender · Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) · closes 30 Sep 2026
marketCards.sowhat: Low value on its own. Bundle with UAE-T-002 into a single DEWA standby-fleet consumables framework proposal.

marketCards.title: Maintenance, repair, rehabilitation and testing of electrical systems, generators, fire alarm and suppression systems and ventilation equipment for nine service centres
marketCards.meta: Tender · Public Utilities Management Company (PUMC), Kuwait · closes 08 Oct 2026
marketCards.sowhat: A multi-site service contract that a Kuwaiti MEP contractor will hold. Cummins Arabia's route is as the genset subcontractor and parts supplier, and to push replacement of end-of-life units during rehabilitation. Kuwait's post-strike grid instability raises the priority of working standby sets at public facilities.

marketCards.title: Ministry of Health package: maintenance, construction and minor expansion of hospitals and health centres (11 packages); main data centre upgrade; nurse call and code blue systems at Jaber Al-Ahmad Hospital
marketCards.meta: Tender · Ministry of Health, Kuwait via CAPT · closes n/d
marketCards.company: Ministry of Health, Kuwait via CAPT
marketCards.sowhat: Kuwait MoH facilities lost grid supply repeatedly during the 2026 strikes and summer faults, which makes hospital standby capacity a live budget line. Work through the eligible contractors on the 11-package tender to place Cummins as the standby genset vendor on hospital expansions.

marketCards.title: Kuwait grid damaged by Iranian strikes: MEW deploys emergency generators and asks for demand cuts
marketCards.meta: Conflict demand · Kuwait · Jul 2026
marketCards.sowhat: Kuwait's standby, rental and rebuild demand is now set by strike events, not planning cycles. Every hospital, water plant and telecom site that ran on grid alone is a prospect for standby sets and service contracts. Cummins Arabia's Kuwait branch is the point of contact; Al Mulla (mtu, Generac) and Al-Bahar (Cat) will be in the same rooms.

marketCards.title: HUMAIN Al-Saad 6 GW AI data centre campus: epc award stage
marketCards.meta: Pipeline · Saudi Arabia · Data centre · 27 Sep 2026
marketCards.company: HUMAIN Al-Saad 6 GW AI data centre campus
marketCards.sowhat: The substations are ordered, so plot-level data hall EPCs and their genset packages are the next procurement wave, likely 2027 into 2028. HUMAIN and its plot tenants (AirTrunk, hyperscalers) will spec through Hatch and JLL. Cummins Arabia should be qualified with HUMAIN's design consultants and with Al Yamama now, and have C3000D6 and C3500 class data centre ratings ready for a 60 Hz Riyadh ambient derate discussion.

sec.read: Six 1 GW plots.

marketCards.title: AWS Saudi Arabia region expansion and UAE zone rebuild: design stage
marketCards.meta: Pipeline · Saudi Arabia · Data centre · 15 Sep 2026
marketCards.company: AWS Saudi Arabia region expansion and UAE zone rebuild
marketCards.sowhat: AWS is shifting Gulf capacity toward Saudi Arabia. Hyperscaler genset packages are placed through global agreements, but hardening requirements after the strikes (dispersed, protected genset yards, longer fuel autonomy) will be set locally. Cummins Arabia should be in front of AWS's Saudi construction team with resilience-focused packaging.

sec.read: Three new Saudi availability zones, each a multi-building campus, implies several hundred MW of standby diesel at 2,750 to 3,500 kVA, 60 Hz.

marketCards.title: MEW post-strike restoration and grid hardening: design stage
marketCards.meta: Pipeline · Kuwait · Utility · 15 Sep 2026
marketCards.company: MEW post-strike restoration and grid hardening
marketCards.sowhat: Kuwait avoided a summer collapse through demand cuts, not new capacity. The 2027 budget cycle (starting April 2027) is where hardening spend lands, and MEW buys through CAPT with local agents. Cummins Arabia should have a Kuwaiti agent positioned with MEW's generation and distribution sectors before tenders appear in early 2027, and a rental partner ready for summer 2027 emergency capacity.

sec.read: MEW and government facility owners will fund backup and black-start capacity: distributed standby diesel at substations, pumping stations and public buildings in 500 to 3,000 kVA units, 50 Hz, and possibly rental or fast-track prime power ahead of summer 2027.

marketCards.title: DataVolt / HUMAIN Oxagon AI data centre: design stage
marketCards.meta: Pipeline · Saudi Arabia · Data centre · 31 Aug 2026
marketCards.company: DataVolt / HUMAIN Oxagon AI data centre
marketCards.sowhat: DataVolt markets net zero, so the standby specification will be contested between diesel with HVO, gas gensets and BESS. Cummins Arabia can offer all three (C3500 class diesel, HSK78G gas, BESS) and should pitch the mixed architecture to DataVolt's engineers in 2027 before the EPC tender.

sec.read: 360 MW first phase implies 400 MW plus of standby diesel or gas generation in 2,500 to 3,500 kVA units, 60 Hz, unless NEOM's renewable-plus-storage supply is accepted as the redundancy layer.

marketCards.title: Microsoft Saudi Arabia East cloud region: genset package expected stage
marketCards.meta: Pipeline · Saudi Arabia · Data centre · 31 Aug 2026
marketCards.company: Microsoft Saudi Arabia East cloud region
marketCards.sowhat: Launch capacity gensets are already installed. The opportunity is service on the installed fleet and the expansion phases, which Microsoft procures through global frameworks. Cummins Arabia's job is to ensure Cummins' global Microsoft relationship is executed locally with Eastern Province service commitments.

sec.read: Initial zones are built; expansion halls and second-wave sites will need additional standby diesel in 2,750 to 3,500 kVA blocks, 60 Hz, from 2027.

marketCards.title: ADNOC Gas Rich Gas Development Phases 2 and 3: epc award stage
marketCards.meta: Pipeline · United Arab Emirates · Oil and gas · 10 Aug 2026
marketCards.company: ADNOC Gas Rich Gas Development Phases 2 and 3
marketCards.sowhat: Wison and Tecnimont will issue genset RFQs within 12 months against ADNOC's approved vendor list. Post-strike, ADNOC is likely to increase emergency generation redundancy, which enlarges the package. Confirm ADNOC vendor status and quote early to both EPCs.

sec.read: Emergency and essential-services diesel gensets for each train and substation, 1,000 to 2,750 kVA, 50 Hz, plus construction prime power at Habshan and Ruwais, both of which sustained strike damage in 2026.

marketCards.title: King Salman International Airport, Terminal 6: epc award stage
marketCards.meta: Pipeline · Saudi Arabia · Airport · 15 Jul 2026
marketCards.sowhat: Substructure is under way, so the main terminal building and MEP contracts follow in 2027 and the genset schedule will be fixed by the airport's MEP consultant. Target the consultant's approved vendor list now; Caterpillar via Zahid will use its Riyadh airport references.

sec.read: Terminal standby power for life safety, baggage, IT and airfield lighting, typically tens of MW in 2,000 to 3,000 kVA units, 60 Hz, tendered with the main terminal MEP package.

marketCards.title: Qiddiya high-speed rail: design stage
marketCards.meta: Pipeline · Saudi Arabia · Transport · 10 Jul 2026
marketCards.sowhat: Rail systems integrators (Alstom, Siemens Mobility, Hitachi, CRRC consortia) carry their own genset frameworks. Engage the civil and systems bidders during tender so Cummins is named as an acceptable alternative in the technical submission.

sec.read: Traction substations, stations and depots each need standby diesel, typically 500 to 2,000 kVA, 60 Hz, specified by the rail systems contractor.

marketCards.title: Expo 2030 Riyadh site: epc award stage
marketCards.meta: Pipeline · Saudi Arabia · Construction / Events · 21 Apr 2026
marketCards.sowhat: Utilities contractors Al Yamama and Nesma are the immediate buyers of site power. Offer sale or rental hybrids to them in 2026; the permanent pavilion standby packages come with the building contracts in 2027 to 2028.

sec.read: Construction-phase prime power for contractors from 2026, then permanent standby for pavilions, transport and command facilities before 2030.

marketCards.title: Kuwait International Airport Terminal 2: genset package expected stage
marketCards.meta: Pipeline · Kuwait · Airport · 24 Mar 2026
marketCards.sowhat: The equipment decision is past, but the operator (DGCA) will tender O&M for the terminal's power plant after handover. A service bid with a Kuwaiti partner in 2027 is realistic, and airport hardening after the drone strikes may add standby capacity.

sec.read: Terminal standby gensets are installed; the opportunity is commissioning support, service contracts and additional resilience capacity after the 2026 drone strikes on the airport, 50 Hz.

marketCards.title: Az-Zour North IWPP Phase 2 and 3: epc award stage
marketCards.meta: Pipeline · Kuwait · Utility / Water · 03 Feb 2026
marketCards.sowhat: SEPCO III will run a Chinese-led procurement and default to its habitual genset vendor unless ACWA Power's O&M arm insists on a brand with Kuwait service. ACWA Operations is the lever; Cummins Arabia's Saudi relationship with ACWA is the way in.

sec.read: Plant emergency diesel and black-start generation for a 2,700 MW CCGT and large SWRO plant, several units in the 2,000 to 3,500 kVA band, 50 Hz, plus construction prime power.

marketCards.title: Ras Mohaisen IWP: epc award stage
marketCards.meta: Pipeline · Saudi Arabia · Water / Desalination · 05 Jan 2026
marketCards.sowhat: Financial close triggers EPC procurement within months. Desalination developers (ACWA Power, Acciona, GS Inima consortia) reuse their previous plant genset vendor; find out who supplied the last SWPC plant by the same EPC and displace on service terms.

sec.read: SWRO plant emergency and black-start diesel for intake, high-pressure pumps and controls, typically two to four units of 1,500 to 3,000 kVA, 60 Hz.

marketCards.title: Mubarak Al-Kabeer Port, Boubyan Island: epc award stage
marketCards.meta: Pipeline · Kuwait · Ports / Logistics · Jan 2026
marketCards.sowhat: Boubyan has weak grid supply, so construction power is a genuine prime-power job now, and CCCC will rent or buy locally. Position through Kuwaiti rental houses and CCCC's Kuwait procurement office in 2026; the permanent standby package follows with the terminal MEP in 2028.

sec.read: Remote island site: multi-MW construction prime power from 2026, then terminal standby for cranes, reefer yards, buildings and navigation systems in 1,000 to 3,000 kVA units, 50 Hz.

marketCards.title: Aramco Jafurah gas development, Phases 3 to 5: epc award stage
marketCards.meta: Pipeline · Saudi Arabia · Oil and gas · 16 Dec 2025
marketCards.company: Aramco Jafurah gas development, Phases 3 to 5
marketCards.sowhat: Aramco emergency gensets are bought by the EPC against Aramco's approved manufacturer list. Cummins Arabia should hold pre-agreed pricing with Tecnicas Reunidas, Sinopec and the Phase 5 bidders; the same EPCs also supply rental prime power for construction camps.

sec.read: Emergency and essential-services diesel gensets at each compression plant and substation, 1,000 to 2,500 kVA, 60 Hz, plus construction-phase prime power at remote sites.

marketCards.title: Stargate UAE, Abu Dhabi: genset package expected stage
marketCards.meta: Pipeline · United Arab Emirates · Data centre · 05 Dec 2025
marketCards.sowhat: Khazna is the largest single genset buyer in the UAE for the next three years. If Cummins is not on Phase 1, the Phase 2 specification cycle in 2026 to 2027 is the entry point, and the argument is delivery slots and service capacity, since all OEMs are supply constrained on 3 MW class data centre sets.

sec.read: Phase 1 gensets are installed or in commissioning.

marketCards.title: Diriyah giga-project: epc award stage
marketCards.meta: Pipeline · Saudi Arabia · Construction / Hospitality · 18 Nov 2025
marketCards.sowhat: Diriyah standardises MEP specifications across districts, so one approved genset brand tends to repeat. Getting on the Diriyah master specification is worth more than any single package.

sec.read: District-level standby for hotels, museums and media studios, many units in the 500 to 2,000 kVA band, 60 Hz, plus construction prime power during 2026 to 2028.

marketCards.title: Microsoft and G42 200 MW UAE expansion: genset package expected stage
marketCards.meta: Pipeline · United Arab Emirates · Data centre · 06 Nov 2025
marketCards.company: Microsoft and G42 200 MW UAE expansion
marketCards.sowhat: Timing means genset orders are being placed now. Any slot Cummins can offer in 2026 or early 2027 is a competitive weapon while other OEMs quote 2028 deliveries.

sec.read: About 230 to 260 MW of standby diesel in 2,750 to 3,500 kVA units, 50 Hz, with orders placed in 2026 to meet a year-end go-live.

marketCards.title: Sabah Al-Ahmad and Al-Mutlaa medical cities: design stage
marketCards.meta: Pipeline · Kuwait · Healthcare · 09 Oct 2025
marketCards.company: Sabah Al-Ahmad and Al-Mutlaa medical cities
marketCards.sowhat: Design consultants will be appointed in 2026 to 2027 and genset packages tendered through CAPT with the main contractors around 2028. Caterpillar via Al-Bahar and Al Mulla's genset division are the entrenched Kuwaiti hospital suppliers; the specification stage is where that default is contested.

sec.read: Four 500 bed hospitals imply roughly 8 to 16 standby gensets of 1,500 to 2,500 kVA, 50 Hz, plus smaller sets for ancillary buildings.

marketCards.title: Cummins raises 2026 outlook; power generation growth limited by capacity, not demand
marketCards.meta: Allocation · Global · Aug 2026
marketCards.sowhat: The parent is allocating large gensets between the US, China, Southeast Asia and the Gulf. A distributor that can show a sourced Gulf pipeline gets slots. This platform is the evidence base for that allocation case: tenders, pipeline signals and rival capacity in one view.

marketCards.title: South Saad Al-Abdullah and South Sabah Al-Ahmad new cities: grid tender stage
marketCards.meta: Pipeline · Kuwait · Utility / Housing · 21 May 2026
marketCards.company: South Saad Al-Abdullah and South Sabah Al-Ahmad new cities
marketCards.sowhat: Substation EPCs in Kuwait (Alghanim, Al-Dhow, HEISCO, Larsen and Toubro) buy station gensets against MEW approved vendor lists. Confirm Cummins approval status with MEW and quote to the substation bidders.

sec.read: Substation auxiliary standby gensets (250 to 1,100 kVA, 50 Hz) and later standby for schools, clinics and government buildings in both cities.

marketCards.title: NREP Round 7 grid connections: grid tender stage
marketCards.meta: Pipeline · Saudi Arabia · Utility · 01 Mar 2026
marketCards.sowhat: Substation EPCs (Al Toukhi, Alfanar, Al Gihaz, Hyundai, Larsen and Toubro) buy station gensets on price and approved vendor status with Saudi Energy. Confirm Cummins' vendor approval for station service gensets and quote to all shortlisted EPCs.

sec.read: Each 380 kV substation requires station auxiliary standby diesel, typically 500 to 1,250 kVA, 60 Hz, and the wind and PV plants need construction power plus O&M building standby.

marketCards.title: Khazna Dammam 200 MW campus: land stage
marketCards.meta: Pipeline · Saudi Arabia · Data centre · 10 Dec 2025
marketCards.sowhat: Khazna's UAE fleet standard is the reference; whoever holds Khazna's UAE genset framework will be the default in Dammam. Cummins Arabia's Dammam base gives it a service argument the UAE incumbent cannot match locally. First phase genset orders should land in the second half of 2026 or early 2027.

sec.read: 200 MW IT load, roughly 230 to 260 MW of standby diesel in 2,500 to 3,500 kVA blocks, 60 Hz, delivered in phases from late 2026.

marketCards.title: US state data centre moratoria (New York EO 62, New Jersey cost-sharing law) trigger Baird downgrade, CAT falls over 6%
marketCards.meta: Regulatory · Caterpillar · 29 Jul 2026
marketCards.sowhat: If US data centre permitting slows, Cat will redirect gensets and sales focus to the Gulf where Saudi and UAE AI campuses face no such moratoria. That raises competitive intensity in KSA and UAE from late 2026. Cummins Arabia should assume more aggressive Cat dealer pricing on large nodes.

marketCards.title: Gulf data centre operators rethink backup after March strikes on AWS UAE and Bahrain
marketCards.meta: Demand shift · UAE and GCC · Aug 2026
marketCards.sowhat: Redundancy is being re-specified across the Gulf: banks and cloud tenants are reviewing where backup capacity sits and how long sites must ride through. That converts into N+1 and 2N standby packages and longer runtime fuel systems, the exact scope Cummins Arabia delivered on the 73.2 MW Saudi hyperscale sites.

marketCards.title: Bahrain, Kuwait and Saudi Arabia most exposed to further infrastructure strikes; UAE risk falling
marketCards.meta: Risk outlook · GCC · Aug 2026
marketCards.sowhat: Resilience budgets will follow exposure. Kuwait and the Saudi Eastern Province are where standby and rental power demand will stay elevated; the UAE returns to a build-out driven market. Cummins Arabia can weight service capacity and rental partnerships toward Kuwait and Dammam.

marketCards.title: Saudi operational data centre capacity reaches 467 MW; national target about 1.5 GW by 2030
marketCards.meta: Market size · Saudi Arabia · Jul 2026
marketCards.sowhat: The genset pool is the delta between 467 MW live and 1.5 GW targeted, times a 1.1 to 1.3 standby ratio: roughly 1.1 to 1.4 GW of standby capacity to be specified in 60 Hz blocks over four years, before HUMAIN's corporate pipeline. That is the number Cummins Arabia should use to justify HHP allocation to the parent.

techCards.title: Baudouin positions 1,900 to 6,250 kVA range for hyperscale campuses and pushes lead time as the decisive variable
techCards.sowhat: This is the sales script Cummins Arabia will meet in Gulf data centre bids: a bigger single unit and a shorter delivery slot. Cummins Arabia needs firm factory slot commitments in its proposals and should quantify Cummins' service network and parts stock in KSA and UAE against Baudouin's thin local footprint.

techCards.title: Liebherr expands Colmar engine plant for Rehlko KD Series data centre demand
techCards.sowhat: Engine supply was the constraint on KD Series volume. Doubling it removes a lead time argument Cummins Arabia could previously use in the 2 MW to 4 MW band. Expect more aggressive KD availability quotes into Gulf data centre projects from 2027.

techCards.title: Modular mtu gas engine power plants launched in 10, 20 and 30 MW blocks, 12 to 18 months to grid
techCards.sowhat: Modular gas blocks with a 12 to 18 month schedule are aimed at exactly the bridging power tenders that Saudi and UAE data centre developers are issuing while grid connections lag. Cummins Arabia's HSK78G offers competitive efficiency but Cummins has not published a comparable pre-engineered block product; Cummins Arabia should build a reference 10 MW HSK78G block design with local balance of plant partners.

techCards.title: Baudouin publishes November 2025 data centre genset rating cards (50 and 60 Hz) covering WPG1900 to WPG5775
techCards.sowhat: The 60 Hz card matters for Saudi Arabia: Baudouin now publishes DCR and DCP ratings at 1800 rpm including 13.8 kV medium voltage sets, which is what Saudi data centre specifications ask for. Cummins Arabia should benchmark its 60 Hz C2500 to C3500 DCC offers against the WPG2500B76 to WPG4000B76 band.

techCards.title: Caterpillar commits USD 725 million to expand Lafayette large engine plant for 3500 series power generation engines
techCards.sowhat: The 3512 and 3516 are the engines behind the gensets Cummins Arabia meets most often in Gulf tenders. More 3500 capacity shortens Cat lead times from 2027, which removes one of the few advantages Cummins has held while Cat allocated engines to US hyperscalers.

techCards.title: Fast-start mtu 20V4000 gas gensets for data centre prime and backup power, 45 second start from 2026
techCards.sowhat: This targets the same grid-constrained data centre prime power need that Cummins addresses with the HSK78G and QSK95 gas sets, and the 60 Hz variant is built for markets like Saudi Arabia. In UAE and KSA data centre campuses where gas is available, mtu can now bid diesel backup, gas prime and dynamic UPS as one package. Cummins Arabia should lead with HSK78G efficiency and Cummins' Gulf gas service record before mtu's 60 Hz set ships.

techCards.title: Baudouin platinum sponsor at Middle East Energy 2025: 20M61 genset (6,250 kVA) pre-launch, 6M31 Stage V PowerKit, 20M55 gas genset
techCards.sowhat: A 6,250 kVA single unit outranks Cummins' largest diesel node and is aimed at hyperscale campuses in the UAE and KSA. Cummins Arabia's counter is the installed base, Cummins factory paralleling and controls, service depth and proven 50 degree C performance. It should also test Baudouin's lead-time claims against real Cummins slot availability when quoting.

sec.read: Market: United Arab Emirates. At Dubai World Trade Centre (stand S3.B40 and outdoor OS.90), Baudouin revealed the 20M61 data centre genset up to 6,250 kVA, launched the 6M31 Stage V-ready PowerKit and showed a 20M55 gas genset up to 5,250 kVA, 12M33 plus SCR Stage V and 6M16 Stage V.

techCards.title: Perkins brings new 2606 (13 L) and 5012 (46 L) engines to Middle East Energy 2025 in Dubai
techCards.sowhat: The 5012 sits exactly on the 1,250 to 1,875 kVA band where Cummins Arabia sells QSK50 and QSK60 based sets into data centres and hospitals, and it is offered to every independent packager in the Gulf. The 2606 attacks the 350 to 550 kVA band with 1,000 hour service intervals. Cummins Arabia should benchmark total cost of ownership against 5012-powered Jubaili and Teksan sets and lead with factory-packaged reliability, local service coverage and 50 degree C ambient performance.

sec.read: Market: United Arab Emirates. Perkins showcased the 2606 (350 to 550 kVA at 50 Hz, available H2 2025, 1,000 hour service intervals, HVO and B100 capable) and the electronic 5012 (1,275 to 1,875 kVA at 50 Hz, 1,125 to 1,500 kWe at 60 Hz, ISO G3, NFPA110, EPA Tier 2 on 60 Hz).

techCards.title: Baudouin launches complete generator sets for data centres, 2,000 to 5,250 kVA (baseline)
techCards.sowhat: This is the structural change: Baudouin now bids as a single-brand genset supplier, not just an engine to local packagers, and it targets the same hyperscale and colocation buyers Cummins Arabia courts in Riyadh, Dammam, Dubai and Abu Dhabi. Cummins Arabia should expect Baudouin gensets in consultant shortlists from 2025 onward.

techCards.title: MHIET sets hydrogen co-firing specifications for KU series gas engines (3.65 to 5.75 MW)
techCards.sowhat: KU series competes with Cummins HSK78G and larger gas engines in industrial CHP and grid support. Gulf gas engine demand from data centres and utilities is growing and Mitsubishi now has a hydrogen-ready spec to offer. Cummins Arabia should sharpen its own fuel flexibility story.

techCards.title: MHIET 500 kW class 100% hydrogen engine generator set reaches commercial readiness level
techCards.sowhat: Relevant to NEOM and UAE hydrogen showcase projects where zero carbon backup power will be specified. Cummins Arabia should be ready to discuss Cummins hydrogen engine roadmap when consultants raise this.

techCards.title: MHI-ESA headline partner at DCD Connect APAC 2026, pitching MGS-R and grid-to-chip resilience
techCards.sowhat: Mitsubishi is marketing MGS as an AI data centre product in Asia. The same hyperscale and colocation operators build in KSA and UAE. Cummins Arabia should track which APAC operators standardise on MGS and prepare Gulf-specific counters.

techCards.title: Generac SD3250 (3.25 MW, Baudouin Baudouin M55) wins Consulting-Specifying Engineer 2026 gold award; large diesel series 1.75 to 3.25 MW
techCards.sowhat: The series maps onto Cummins Arabia's C2000 to C3500 data centre band. Note the engine is Baudouin, so the product competes on Generac packaging and Baudouin lead time, not on a proprietary engine.

techCards.title: FG Wilson gensets pass HVO field trials with Tria Energy
techCards.sowhat: HVO acceptance is becoming a standard question in data centre tenders in the UAE. FG Wilson now has published trial evidence to cite. Cummins Arabia should have equivalent HVO approval statements for its data centre range ready in tender documents.

techCards.title: Rehlko introduces next-generation APM804 control platform
techCards.sowhat: Controls and paralleling are a decision factor for data centre consultants. Cummins Arabia should ensure PowerCommand paralleling and monitoring capabilities are presented head to head with APM804 in consultant briefings.

techCards.title: Volvo Penta publishes data centre backup power positioning: Tier 4 Final platform, modular approach, independent partner to OEMs and system integrators
techCards.sowhat: Volvo's data centre pitch is modular many-small-units, which fits edge and enterprise sites rather than the hyperscale campuses driving Gulf demand. Cummins Arabia should watch packager bids on edge data centres in UAE.

techCards.title: FG Wilson lists new 'M' variants across the large range (P1100-1M to P2500-3M) with DSE7410 control
techCards.sowhat: FG Wilson's top end remains 2,500 kVA on the mechanical 4016-61TRG3 while the electronic 5016 is sold to other packagers. Cummins Arabia's C2500 to C3500 range and its factory data centre ratings remain a differentiator above 2,500 kVA and in DCC rated applications. Below 2,500 kVA expect the refreshed FG Wilson range to be pushed hard by TAMGO and FG Wilson FZE.

techCards.title: Perkins shows 2600 Series, hydrogen hybrid IOPU and battery-electric power unit at CONEXPO 2026
techCards.sowhat: Hybrid and alternative fuel work is still at prototype stage for Perkins and is aimed at off-highway more than gensets. The relevant signal is the Stage V 2600 Series, which packagers can pair with Gulf tenders that start asking for Stage V or Tier 4 Final in urban and data centre sites. Cummins Arabia should keep its own Stage V and Tier 4 Final genset offer visible to consultants in UAE and KSA.

techCards.title: Volvo Penta introduces G17 natural gas engine for power generation, aimed at data centres and utilities
techCards.sowhat: Adds a gas option at the 17 litre node for packagers. In the Gulf the relevant overlap is with Cummins gas gensets in the 400 to 700 kW band for oil and gas and utility sites in KSA and Kuwait.

techCards.title: First emergency gensets with verified Environmental Product Declarations: 16V4000 DS2500 and 10V1600
techCards.sowhat: EPDs will be asked for by hyperscalers and by UAE and Saudi green building schemes. If a UAE data centre RFP requires EPDs, Cummins Arabia needs Cummins' equivalent documentation ready or it loses on a compliance line rather than on price.

techCards.title: Rehlko launches all-new KD Series 60 to 600 kW generators

m33.title: Bahrain, Kuwait and Saudi Arabia most exposed to further infrastructure strikes; UAE risk falling
m33.what: ACLED counted at least 172 attacks on non-military infrastructure across the six GCC states between 28 February and 30 July 2026 and assesses Bahrain, Kuwait and Saudi Arabia as most exposed to future attacks, with UAE risk likely reduced after its re-engagement with Iran.
m33.why: Resilience budgets will follow exposure. Kuwait and the Saudi Eastern Province are where standby and rental power demand will stay elevated; the UAE returns to a build-out driven market. Cummins Arabia can weight service capacity and rental partnerships toward Kuwait and Dammam.

m34.title: Saudi operational data centre capacity reaches 467 MW; national target about 1.5 GW by 2030
m34.what: MCIT counted 467 MW of operational data centre capacity in Q1 2026, up from 440 MW at end 2025. The official national target is about 1.5 GW by 2030; the 6 GW and 6.6 GW figures in circulation are HUMAIN corporate pipelines.
m34.why: The genset pool is the delta between 467 MW live and 1.5 GW targeted, times a 1.1 to 1.3 standby ratio: roughly 1.1 to 1.4 GW of standby capacity to be specified in 60 Hz blocks over four years, before HUMAIN's corporate pipeline. That is the number Cummins Arabia should use to justify HHP allocation to the parent.

m35.title: Cummins raises 2026 outlook; power generation growth limited by capacity, not demand
m35.what: Cummins reported record Q2 2026 revenue of USD 9.5 billion, raised full-year growth guidance to 10 to 13 percent, and said global power generation revenue is projected up 15 to 25 percent with growth limited by capacity rather than customer demand; capital investment of USD 1.35 to 1.45 billion supports capacity expansion through 2030.
m35.why: The parent is allocating large gensets between the US, China, Southeast Asia and the Gulf. A distributor that can show a sourced Gulf pipeline gets slots. This platform is the evidence base for that allocation case: tenders, pipeline signals and rival capacity in one view.

CATERPIL.name: Caterpillar
CATERPIL.sector: Data centre · Oil & gas · Construction · Rental · Mining · Marine
CATERPIL.assess: Caterpillar is the incumbent spec in Gulf data centres, giga-projects and Aramco sites, sold through Zahid Tractor (22 to 24 Saudi branches, dealer since 1950) and Al-Bahar (UAE, Kuwait). Altaaqa's 1 GW Cat rental fleet absorbs outage-driven demand before any sale is tendered. Cat's large-engine capacity is being consumed by US AI builds through 2027, so delivery slots in the Gulf are the field where Cummins Arabia can move.
CATERPIL.updates: Zahid Tractor & Heavy Machinery Co. Ltd. (Zahid Group) (KSA) · Altaaqa Alternative Solutions (Zahid Group) (KSA) · Altaaqa Global (Zahid Group) (UAE) · EJAR Cat Rental Store (Zahid Group) (KSA)

partners.label: Zahid Tractor & Heavy Machinery Co. Ltd. (Zahid Group)
partners.note: Sole Cat dealer for Saudi Arabia covering machines, engines, electric power, marine, oil and gas and Cat mining; 22 to 24 branches; engine rebuild centres Jeddah and Dammam; embedded site technicians on strategic projects Also holds franchises for Perkins / FG Wilson.
partners.insight: [CORE] Sole Cat dealer for Saudi Arabia covering machines, engines, electric power, marine, oil and gas and Cat mining; 22 to 24 branches; engine rebuild centres Jeddah and Dammam; embedded site technicians on strategic projects Multi-brand holder: also carries Perkins / FG Wilson.
partners.mean: Threat: Seventy-five years of relationships with Aramco, SEC, giga-project developers and contractors give Cat first call on Saudi power tenders. Cummins Arabia competes against a dealer with more service points than it has; the counter is faster quotes, guaranteed lead times and total cost of ownership at the node level. · source

partners.label: Mohamed Abdulrahman Al-Bahar L.L.C.
partners.note: Cat dealer for UAE, Kuwait, Qatar and Bahrain (Oman via associate Oasis Trading); power systems sales, packaging, rental power with nine regional depots, CVAs, switchgear, UPS, ATS and load banks
partners.insight: [CORE] Cat dealer for UAE, Kuwait, Qatar and Bahrain (Oman via associate Oasis Trading); power systems sales, packaging, rental power with nine regional depots, CVAs, switchgear, UPS, ATS and load banks
partners.mean: Threat: Al-Bahar is the direct competitor to Cummins Arabia in UAE and Kuwait for every hospital, metro, oil and gas and data centre standby package. Its rental fleet lets it seed accounts with temporary power and convert to permanent Cat sets, a motion Cummins Arabia should match with its own rental partners. · source

partners.label: Altaaqa Alternative Solutions (Zahid Group)
partners.note: Largest single owner of Cat rental generators in the world, over 1 GW, 62 kVA to 2,000 kVA, six depots plus 17 Zahid branches, turnkey rental power plants for oil and gas, mining, cities and remote sites Also holds franchises for Perkins / FG Wilson.
partners.insight: [CORE] Largest single owner of Cat rental generators in the world, over 1 GW, 62 kVA to 2,000 kVA, six depots plus 17 Zahid branches, turnkey rental power plants for oil and gas, mining, cities and remote sites Multi-brand holder: also carries Perkins / FG Wilson.
partners.mean: Threat: Every MW Altaaqa deploys is a Cat MW and often becomes a permanent Cat sale. Cummins Arabia should target the rental buyers who want a second OEM for fleet resilience and price competition, and should protect its own rental partner relationships in KSA. · source

partners.label: Altaaqa Global (Zahid Group) and Caterpillar
partners.note: Caterpillar International Power Projects partner for 20 to 100+ MW temporary power plants across Africa, Middle East, Latin America and Asia, Dubai based Also holds franchises for Perkins / FG Wilson.
partners.insight: [ADJACENT] Caterpillar International Power Projects partner for 20 to 100+ MW temporary power plants across Africa, Middle East, Latin America and Asia, Dubai based Multi-brand holder: also carries Perkins / FG Wilson.
partners.mean: Watch: Gives Cat a utility-scale temporary power channel that Cummins Arabia does not have in the Gulf. Relevant when Kuwait MEW or Saudi utilities seek bridging power; Cummins Arabia should partner with an IPP-style rental operator for those tenders. · source

partners.label: EJAR Cat Rental Store (Zahid Group)
partners.note: Cat Rental Store franchise in Saudi Arabia with mobile generator sets among rental lines; locations include Makkah and Dammam; part of Zahid's 2026 Sales Campus organisation Also holds franchises for Perkins / FG Wilson.
partners.insight: [ADJACENT] Cat Rental Store franchise in Saudi Arabia with mobile generator sets among rental lines; locations include Makkah and Dammam; part of Zahid's 2026 Sales Campus organisation Multi-brand holder: also carries Perkins / FG Wilson.
partners.mean: Watch: Small and mid-size rental gensets feed contractor relationships that later specify permanent standby sets. Cummins Arabia should ensure its C-series and QSK rental units are positioned with Saudi contractors through its own rental channel. · source

partners.label: Red Sea Global (The Red Sea Project)

partners.insight: [ADJACENT] 69 Cat gensets, 32 MW prime power, B100 biodiesel capable, Cat Connect remote monitoring and CVAs supplied by Zahid Tractor for construction phase power
partners.mean: Watch: Cat holds the incumbent position on the Red Sea giga-project and its renewable fuel narrative. For permanent power phases (hotels, airport), Cummins Arabia should bid with HVO-compatible sets and hybrid microgrid options before the incumbent locks the follow-on. · source

partners.mean: Watch: Al-Bahar has a live UAE reference for single-supplier solar, genset and storage integration. Cummins Arabia should have a comparable hybrid reference in UAE or KSA to avoid losing agri, industrial and remote-site microgrid tenders on integration credibility. · source

profile.employees: Approximately 118,000 full-time employees as of 2025-12-31 (51,600 US, 66,400 outside US), per FY2025 Form 10-K
profile.revenue: FY2025 sales and revenues USD 67.6 billion (record; Q4 2025 USD 19.1 billion). Power & Energy segment Q4 2025 sales USD 9.4 billion (+23%), segment profit USD 1.841 billion (19.6% margin). Power Generation sales exceeded USD 10 billion in 2025, up more than 30% (CEO, Q4 2025 call). Power & Energy FY2025 revenue reported at USD 28.6 billion, 42% of company revenue (Zacks analysis). Q2 2026 company sales USD 20.5 billion (+24%), Power & Energy USD 8.2 billion (+17%), power generation retail sales +72%
profile.industry: Construction and mining equipment, diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines, electric power generation (diesel and gas generator sets, energy storage, microgrid controls), Cat Financial
profile.positioning: Caterpillar is the incumbent premium power generation brand in the Gulf, selling through two long-standing exclusive dealers: Zahid Tractor in Saudi Arabia (Cat dealer since 1950, 22 to 24 branches) and Mohamed Abdulrahman Al-Bahar in the UAE, Kuwait, Qatar and Bahrain (headquartered in Sharjah, Oman covered through associate Oasis Trading). Its Gulf reach is reinforced by the Zahid Group rental arm Altaaqa, the largest single owner of Cat rental generators in the world at over 1 GW, and by Caterpillar's own Middle East Distribution Center, district office and Learning Center in Jebel Ali. Globally, Cat is converting the AI data centre boom into record backlog and is tripling large reciprocating engine capacity to about three times 2024 levels by 2030, which means the 3516E, C175 and G3520K nodes that compete head on with Cummins in the 1.5 to 4 MW band will be more available and more aggressively marketed in the region from 2027
